CHAPTER 4 · ITEM 03 / 10

Demand and supply

Demand determinants需求因素

YOUR CHECKBOX · 原始清單項目

Predict demand shifts caused by income (normal versus inferior goods), related goods (substitutes versus complements), tastes, expectations and the number of buyers.

01 · UNDERSTAND / 概念解釋

收入增加令正常品需求增、劣等品需求減；替代品價格升令本品需求增，互補品價格升令本品需求減。喜好、預期及買家數也影響需求。

Income raises demand for normal goods and lowers demand for inferior goods. A substitute's higher price raises own demand; a complement's higher price lowers it. Tastes, expected future prices and buyer numbers can also shift demand.

02 · WORKED EXAMPLE / 一個示範

See it in action.

Example 例：Gasoline and cars are complements. More expensive gasoline can reduce demand for cars, shifting car demand left. 汽油更貴會降低汽車需求。

03 · TRY IT / 例題練習

One question. Your turn.

Tea substitutes for coffee. Tea price rises. Coffee demand? 茶價升時咖啡需求？
